name: Just-In-Time Activation Failed
description: Notifies the identity who attempted to initiate a Just-In-Time activation window that the attempt did not succeed.
subject: Just-In-Time activation failed for ${entitlementName}
body:
Just-In-Time Activation Failed

Dear $__recipient.name,

The Just-In-Time duration window you attempted to activate for ${entitlementName} did not succeed.

Entitlement

${entitlementName}

#if($activationUrl)

You may return to $__global.productName here and attempt to activate the entitlement again.

#end

Please contact ${ownerName} if you have any questions.

Thank you,
The $__global.productName Team
